narrative: The late-June CVE wave lands directly on the multi-tenant agent-builder surface this prediction targets, with the Flowise Custom MCP Server command-injection RCE (CVSS 9.9) clearing the 9.0+ bar outright as an authenticated user escalates past a broken command-flag blocklist to run arbitrary host commands, amid a wider 9.6-9.8 cluster across Crawl4AI, Langflow, and AutoGen Studio.
remaining_gap: Flowise scopes on an authenticated user, not an explicitly named cross-tenant authorization break, so the strict cross-tenant framing is only partially matched.
